placements.role: Produces copper that can supply the global conductor demand pool used by long-distance transmission and hydro equipment.

role_evidence.claim: Freeport-McMoRan describes itself as one of the world's largest publicly traded copper producers and reported 2025 copper production.

business_summary: Freeport-McMoRan Inc. is a US, NYSE-listed (FCX) copper mining company operating large-scale mines in North America, South America and Indonesia (Grasberg). It describes itself as one of the world's largest publicly traded copper producers. Its copper output is the mapped exposure to the tibet-mega-dam chain's copper-conductors link, though as a global commodity producer its revenue is not tied to any single project.

exposure_summary.narrative: Freeport-McMoRan sits on copper-conductors, scored QUIET. The company's own 2025 Form 10-K describes it as one of the world's largest publicly traded copper producers, but the link's own bottleneck note calls copper a global commodity where this project moves sentiment more than physical balances; no Tibet-basin-specific revenue percentage is disclosed or sourced.

disclosed_revenue_exposure.basis: no revenue percentage tied to the tibet-mega-dam exposure is sourced for Freeport-McMoRan this run; see data_gaps.

latest_fy.source_name: SEC EDGAR XBRL companyfacts, read from data/market/FCX.json fundamentals (source sec-companyfacts)
latest_fy.basis: Revenues for fiscal year ended 2025-12-31 as reported to SEC XBRL.

revenue_cagr_3y.source_name: SEC EDGAR XBRL companyfacts, read from data/market/FCX.json fundamentals (source sec-companyfacts)
revenue_cagr_3y.basis: Three-year compound annual revenue growth computed as (25186000000 / 23271000000) ** (1/3) - 1 from the companyfacts Revenues series, fiscal year ended 2022-12-31 to fiscal year ended 2025-12-31.

operating_margin.source_name: SEC EDGAR XBRL companyfacts, read from data/market/FCX.json fundamentals (source sec-companyfacts)
operating_margin.basis: Operating income 6518000000 divided by revenue 25186000000 for the fiscal year ended 2025-12-31, both from companyfacts.

fcf_margin.source_name: SEC EDGAR XBRL companyfacts, read from data/market/FCX.json fundamentals (source sec-companyfacts)
fcf_margin.basis: Operating cash flow 5610000000 minus capital expenditure 4494000000, divided by revenue 25186000000, for the fiscal year ended 2025-12-31, all from companyfacts. operating_cash_flow_to_net_income is omitted from this group (not written as NULL) because the schema requires only one of the two cash-conversion fields and this one is measurable; companyfacts returns an empty net_income_fy series for Freeport-McMoRan so the other field cannot be computed.

net_debt_to_ebitda.source_name: SEC EDGAR XBRL companyfacts, read from data/market/FCX.json fundamentals (source sec-companyfacts)
net_debt_to_ebitda.basis: Net debt (total_debt 8166000000 minus cash 4080000000, both as of the interim balance-sheet date 2026-06-30) divided by EBITDA (operating income 6518000000 plus depreciation 2244000000, both for fiscal year ended 2025-12-31), all from companyfacts. The balance-sheet inputs are an interim date roughly six months after the income-statement fiscal year-end (the only total_debt/cash observations companyfacts returns), a smaller mismatch than would block the figure but flagged here explicitly.

data/market/FCX.json carries no pcs (positioning/crowdedness-signal) block, so this profile cannot independently corroborate the link-level crowdedness score with issuer-level analyst-coverage or institutional-ownership figures.

disposition.basis: Complete medium profile on copper-conductors (QUIET) with a real, filing-referenced role and a computed revenue/growth/margin/cash-conversion/leverage set from SEC companyfacts, but quality, valuation and reverse-DCF are NULL because data/market/FCX.json has never had its quality computation run (no quality block on file at all, unlike peer issuers). confidence_audit.basis: Counts cover the canonical metric fields only (cash_conversion writes only fcf_margin, valuation writes market_cap and price_to_sales, so 10 fields total rather than 11). VERIFIED is the one figure read directly off SEC companyfacts as reported (latest_fy revenue). INFERRED covers figures computed from companyfacts with the derivation named in each basis (growth, margins, cash_conversion, leverage). NULL covers both quality scores, both valuation fields and both reverse-DCF fields, all traced to the absence of a quality block in data/market/FCX.json rather than judgement.

notes: Profiles are medium-depth reusable research. This file carries no final verdict, no entry zone and no red team; those belong to the deep-dive stage.
Data tier (T1/T2/T3) describes data availability. Opportunity tier (O1/O2/O3) describes research priority. Neither implies the other.

This run computed leverage (net_debt_to_ebitda) by pairing an interim (2026-06-30) balance-sheet total_debt/cash reading against a fiscal-year-2025 income-statement EBITDA; the roughly six-month period mismatch is named in the field's own basis rather than treated as disqualifying, unlike the multi-year staleness that blocks other issuers' leverage fields.
